title: Ladder season body
description: A ladder season of a game (register row DK1741; spec-delta S1598; docs/institutions/games-and-arena.md 3 to 6): a 28-day season in which entrants are paired by a DRAW from a published seed that no entrant chooses, and a rating counts only a drawn pairing. Signed by the operator as the referee. The seed is published here, before play; entries close at `entry_closes_at`; rounds are drawn from the entrants after that. Chain: none (prev is null).
